switch.name: BOX Jade standard-height soldered clicky switch
switch.notes: Manufacturer PDF actual page4 outer profile; actual page11 plate and loading parameters. 1.50 +/-0.10 is plate thickness, not PCB thickness. Stem cross section and inner BOX guide opening are undimensioned: custom keycap stem/boss fit remains provisional. Price normalized per switch from INR280 ten-pack; purchase three packs, thirty switches. Added source profile dimensions from actual PDFpage4: width over latches14.87+/-0.5, opposite-view bodyheight10.70, centerpost diameter3.85+0/-0.1 and projection1.40. steppedBaseHeight0.50 is the arithmetic difference11.20-10.70 between profile datums, not a separately toleranced manufacturer callout. Undimensioned housing taper, LED window, terminal shapes/lengths and BOX/stem internal geometry remain approximate contours, never measured dimensions.

stabilizer.name: 2u PCB-mounted leveling mechanism
stabilizer.notes: Exact catalogue drawing reference, not stocked Indian procurement confirmation. Printed p70 identifies A=23.8 for 2u; p71 PCB pattern. Y signs are local convention and may be mirrored as a whole. Housing details not fully dimensioned; render bracket geometry as approximation. Do not substitute generic +/-12mm cap stem centers.

controller.name: RP2040-Tiny main controller module
controller.notes: Official V1.1 STEP overall height2.875103mm: PCBbottom-1.000003 to highest FPC feature1.8751. Rounded conservative2.87511 model envelope; highest component is FPC connector, likely actuator-open CAD. Other components alone fit about2.05 overall. Detailed original-frame datums/mesh in spec/references/waveshare/controller-datums.json. Price is full kit including adapter and FPC, not charged twice; Hubtronics listing showed zero stock.

usb_adapter.name: Remote USB-C adapter board
usb_adapter.notes: Official STEP assembled bbox is not a socket-mouth datum. Extract connector front face/center, PCB surfaces, FPC outlet and mounting features directly from official STEP before claiming flush fit. Included in controller kit; separate price unknown.

encoder.name: Rotary encoder with push switch
encoder.notes: Use PEC11R-4xxxF-Sxxxx drawing, PDFpage2 bottom; L15 table PDFpage3. 24 detents and 24 pulses. BodyHeight6.5 is PCB mounting datum to bushing shoulder; L15 is shoulder to tip. Default drawing tolerances <10mm +/-0.3, >=10mm +/-0.5 unless called out.

key_led.name: Top-emitting white per-key LED
key_led.notes: Package drawing sourced. Optical passage through selected BOX Jade and custom cap legend is provisional; no physical brightness or optical validation. Footprint/orientation belongs to future electronics work.

led_driver.name: 36-channel white LED PWM driver
led_driver.notes: QFN44 5x5 package. Height/pad layout and support circuit must use package drawing before board manufacture. Model is an unrouted PCB planning representation.

rgb_strip.name: Base RGB LED strip, white flex PCB
rgb_strip.notes: 144pixels/m, covered strip10.4x4.3mm; bare strip7.5mm wide is different envelope. Installed segment length/count belongs to assembly. Purchase full1m; no Indian INR quote verified. Full-power electrical budget not validated.

logic_buffer.name: 5V RGB data logic buffer
logic_buffer.notes: Selected electrical/package reference only. Exact DBV package and support components need drawing verification; no complete electronics design claimed.

magnet.name: Captive riser attachment disc magnet
magnet.notes: Axially magnetized N42 NiCuNi. Six total: two in case, two in 4deg bar, two in 7deg bar; only four installed in one tilted assembly. Pocket clearance, positive retaining closure and keyed shear seat are custom assembly decisions. Published thick-steel pull force is not riser retention performance. No verified Indian exact-SKU INR quote.

rubber_foot.name: Clear hemispherical adhesive contact foot
rubber_foot.notes: Four flat-case contacts plus two contacts per alternative bar = eight purchased/modelled. Contact compression, adhesive and printed substrate adhesion remain unverified.

fastener.name: M2 x 6 socket cap enclosure screw
fastener.notes: Six total: four enclosure screws plus two USB adapter cradle/clamp screws. Adapter has no mounting screw holes; screws close an external clamp, never pass through invented board holes. Nominal DIN912 head envelope; exact tolerances and final length stack remain unverified.

fastener_nut.name: M2 captive hex nut
fastener_nut.notes: Six captive nuts for four enclosure screws and two USB cradle/clamp screws. DIN934 nominal width4mm; custom pocket clearances and final length stack remain provisional.

pcb.name: Unrouted custom carrier PCB
pcb.notes: PCBtop datum -5mm relative plateTop0. Thickness1.5 selected model decision compatible with stabilizer; not an inferred Kailh PCB requirement. Outline/holes/supports in assembly spec. No routed/manufacturing PCB.

plate.name: Custom switch support plate
plate.notes: PlateTop0; cutouts14x14 with R<=.3 per switch drawing. Mirror black appearance is finish target; manufacturing process/tolerance unknown.

keycap_1u.name: Custom navy 1u shallow-dish keycap
keycap_1u.notes: Custom nominal geometry only. White legend inlays; print process/material and crosssocket/BOX internal boss fit unverified. Assembly controls roof/stem/skirt dimensions.

keycap_2u.name: Custom navy 2u Space keycap
keycap_2u.notes: Three sockets: central switch and two stabilizer axes +/-11.9mm. Exact stem socket/fit provisional.

knob.name: Custom dark navy encoder knob
knob.notes: Assembly defines diameter/height/shaft seat and clearances; D-shaft fit and positive push clearance provisional.

case.name: Custom frosted enclosure and mirror black top
case.notes: Nominal integration envelope only; root assembly controls outline, walls, mounts and datums. Case price excludes the separately listed 4deg and7deg risers. Printed and optical fit unverified.

overlay.name: Removable macro legend overlay concept
overlay.notes: Top-right dial notch; concept-only material/skin thickness and automatic profile identification remain unimplemented.

fpc_cable.name: Kit 8-pin USB interconnect flex cable
fpc_cable.notes: Manufacturer kit approx15cm cable. Connector pitch/contact side/cable width/thickness and minimum bend radius require official CAD/detail confirmation. Any illustrated bend radius is an explicit assembly assumption. Included in controller kit.

diode.name: Per-key matrix anti-ghosting diode
diode.notes: SOD-123 package; one diode per28switches. Package model only; polarity and matrix connections require schematic/routing review. Manufacturer reel ordering quantities are not a small-quantity purchase quote; distributor cut-tape MOQ and spares unresolved.

riser_4.name: Custom full-width magnetic4degree riser bar
riser_4.notes: Assembly defines rounded full-width bar dimensions, keyed seat and captive magnet pockets. Separate printed part price; magnets/feet listed elsewhere. One of two alternatives installed at a time, or neither for flat use.

riser_7.name: Custom full-width magnetic7degree riser bar
riser_7.notes: Assembly defines rounded full-width bar dimensions, keyed seat and captive magnet pockets. Separate printed part price; magnets/feet listed elsewhere. One of two alternatives installed at a time, or neither for flat use.
